title: Towards VWA of Affective Noise in SET
prompt:
# Codex PPT Slide Image Prompt

## Canvas
16:9 full-slide PowerPoint image, English, no visible slide number.

## Use Case
precise-object-edit; make two exact edits to the existing approved title slide while preserving all other content and design.

## Input Images
- Image 1: existing slide 1 edit target. Preserve its background, title hierarchy, subtitle, 17,127 metric, metadata block, curve motif, icons, logos, palette, typography, and spacing except for the two requested changes.
- Image 2: approved slide 31 style reference. Match palette, typography mood, texture, and polish only.
- Image 3: strict supplied Wilfrid Laurier University logo. Preserve exactly.
- Image 4: strict supplied white-background AMMCS logo. Preserve exactly.

## Exact Visible Text
Title: "Towards VWA of Affective Noise in SET"
Subtitle: "An interpretable ABSA framework that adjusts SET ratings by down-weighting construct-irrelevant emotion."
Authors: "B. Obeidi, S. Fatahi, A. A. Bidgoli"
Institution: "Wilfrid Laurier University, Ontario, Canada"
Date: "August 2026"
Session: "Special Session: SS-MFRA"
Corpus statistic: "17,127"
Combined corpus source and unit: "RateMyProfessors Reviews"

## Primary Request
1. Change only V.W.A to VWA in the title. The title must read exactly "Towards VWA of Affective Noise in SET" with no periods in VWA and no terminal period.
2. Replace the two separate RateMyProfessors and Reviews zones with one rounded bubble arranged in this exact left-to-right order: star-in-speech-bubble icon, the single text string "RateMyProfessors Reviews", review speech-bubble icon. Keep 17,127 as a separate metric zone to the left.

## Layout Invariant
Preserve the approved cover layout and every other visual element. The combined corpus bubble should be compact, balanced, and fully readable, with both icons inside the same bubble at opposite sides of the text. Do not add separators, duplicate icons, or split RateMyProfessors and Reviews into separate bubbles.

## Constraints
- Render every exact text string verbatim.
- VWA must have no periods.
- The title must have no terminal period.
- The combined bubble must be: star icon | RateMyProfessors Reviews | review icon.
- Preserve all other text, the 17,127 metric, metadata, icons, and both logos.
- Add no other wording.
- No watermark and no visible slide number.
- No overlaps or truncation.
